card.name: Судейская палата
card.description: Один раз запретите всем игрокам строительство на следующий раунд

userFeedback.verbatim: Стол показан хорошо. Я хочу увидеть большой зал с оттенками зеленой палитры. Больше напряжения на картинку добавь. Людей много и их лица почти неразличимы, схема зала квадратная. в центре стоит осужденный Магистран, это средний план, ближе к дальнему. свет вечерний, но не заливает всю комнату.
userFeedback.interpretation: Магистран treated as the game character Магистрат, id 1_3, per parent task instruction.

visualChecks.method: Direct manual inspection of generated result and saved PNG using view_image. Text checked word by word. Artistic scene checks are visual observations, not architectural measurement or OCR.

retainedDeskAndPOV.observed: Same narrow wooden desk across nearest foreground, Justice statue low left, gavel and block low right, papers and books; view from seated judge position into hall, no visible judge.

squarePlanHall.observed: Broad open central paved area, benches along both side walls and rear, wide back wall and readable rear corner relationships; elevated general view avoids long narrow nave.
squarePlanHall.limitation: Exact equality of width and depth cannot be proved from a single painted perspective; near floor corners meet foreground/card edges.

greenPalette.observed: Muted green-grey stone, dark olive banners and broad cool green floor; dark wooden structure and green shadows dominate interior. Parchment/gold UI stays warm.

tension.observed: Lone small accused figure under attention of gathered dim spectators, closed hands, open empty floor and dark enclosed room convey a grave public trial; no violence or execution.

manyIndistinctFaces.observed: Dozens of spectators grouped on side and back benches, heads small and subdued; no collection of bright close-up portraits.
manyIndistinctFaces.limitation: Some front-row faces and a pair of rear guards retain individually legible painted features at full PNG size; not every face is completely indistinguishable.

solitaryDistantMagistrate.observed: One small full-body man stands alone near the far half of central open floor. Balding head, tiny glasses, beard, red outer robe and yellow inner garment evoke approved Magistrate; hands clasped. Foreground floor remains empty.
solitaryDistantMagistrate.scaleObservation: Figure roughly 200 px tall in approximately 1050 px artwork height; slightly larger than the 15–18% prompt target but clearly a small mid-to-far-ground figure, not a portrait.

localEveningLight.observed: Two window areas show restrained pink/orange dusk. Most hall remains cool green; left window casts a localized diagonal warm patch across part of the floor and slight warmth near Magistrate.
localEveningLight.limitation: A multi-candle chandelier and several wall candles add more small warm lights than the prompt’s few-candles wording, but there is no pervasive orange room fill.

typography.observed: Thin regular black ability and compact bold black title remain like v2; no return to v1 oversized heavy body text.
